name: Build: Ambient occlusion
body: SSAO or GTAO from the depth buffer, darkening creases and contact points of the ambient term. One PR based on nox-proto, with before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: SSAO over the depth buffer (D-067): ao.frag, ao-blur.frag, RecordAmbientOcclusion, PostSettings.ambientOcclusion*, SetAmbientOcclusion, guide docs/ambient-occlusion.md. 204 of 204 tests on lavapipe. Metal and real-GPU timing unchecked; this is the costliest effect so far.
